notes: The volume installer grows up for a 17GB job. It was built for LoRA files of a hundred megabytes: it gave every download twelve minutes before calling the pod stuck, and it confirmed arrival by listing the loras folder — which would never contain a Kontext model, so a Kontext install could never be seen finishing. The deadline now scales with what is actually being downloaded, up to forty-five minutes for the full Kontext set, and the arrival check looks in the folder each file is going to: loras and diffusion_models can both be listed by asking ComfyUI to refuse a name that cannot exist. Since text encoders and the VAE have no such probe, the Kontext files are now downloaded smallest first, so the big model arriving is proof that everything before it already landed. Re-running Install is still safe at any point — finished files are skipped.
